_comment: Subsystem modules for module-scoped audits (Development_Tools/ModuleMap/module_map.py). Every tracked file belongs to exactly one module, is a sharedTable (rows attributed by the UID or LocalizationKey they name), or is a picture/.art file owned by the module whose card names it. A beast's name recurs across its spirit, charm and coat (lynx), so those globs are anchored by prefix (spirit_lynx, charm_, coat_). Animals/, Encounter/ and SelfTriggeredAction/ are not card folders, so their files are claimed by name globs. `module_map.py check HarshWilds` must exit 0.

modules.name: Creatures
modules.summary: Lynx, wisent and musk ox: their Animals manifests, encounters, trapped and carcass cards (bled, skinned), and their threat switches.

modules.name: Bandit
modules.summary: The bandit: Animals manifest, encounter, body card, age and robbed stats, the theft trigger and its fail-closed BanditTheftGuard.

modules.name: Rare Beasts
modules.summary: White wisent, lake beast, frost demon and lindwurm (with the Lindwurm Fang): manifests, encounters, carcasses, presence stats, switches and arrival triggers.

modules.name: Raids
modules.summary: Eagle, black bear, wolverine and heron raid cards, their clocks, switches and triggers, the raid-pressure tune stat, and the fail-closed HeronRaidGuard.

modules.name: Hazards
modules.summary: Adder (venom), smithing burns and foraging bites (their force stats, ActionRouter hooks and the shared HwNotice popup), and the mud volcano.

modules.name: World Events
modules.summary: Drought and dry spell, insect plague (bug swarm, Bug Trap), crop blight and BlightSpreadGuard, blood moon (with its two extra lynxes), eclipse, aurora, cold snap and algae bloom.

modules.name: Afflictions
modules.summary: Fleas and lice (Herbal Wash), tooth decay (Chewing Stick, Tooth Puller), spirit sickness (Exorcism Smudge) and dancing plague, with their stats, switches and triggers.

modules.name: Spirits
modules.summary: Lynx, Goat, Blood, Dragon and Ancestor Spirits: summoning and calling blueprints, essences, encounter/granted/angry/left events, bound and encountered stats, insight triggers, and the Stone Cairn.

modules.name: Rites
modules.summary: Mistletoe and Bless the Grove, the Athame and its Let Blood / Call Rain rites with IncenseRiteGuard, and the Casting Bones with their omen cards.

modules.name: Brews and Witchfire
modules.summary: Beast Brew, Earth Brew and Musclebrew (blueprints, liquids, effect stats) and the Witchfire (unlit, lit, spent).

modules.name: Ritual Objects
modules.summary: Spirit Jar, Spirit Mask, the four spirit charms, the Lynx, Musk Ox and Wisent Coats, the Lynx Cloak, and the Beast Totem.

modules.name: Fair Folk
modules.summary: Banshee, nixie, selkie and the Wild Hunt (events, clocks, switches, triggers), and the Threshold Stone with its offering stat.

modules.name: Fairy Ring and Realms
modules.summary: Fairy Ring, Moon Basin and the Faerie, Moon and Underworld realms (envs, locations, exits, clocks, in-realm stats), the Fairy King and Queen with their bargains and dialogs, the three realm dangers, the realm encounter guard, and Forest Lore's Ancient Cairn door.

modules.name: Wandering Shaman
modules.summary: The seasonal shaman visitor: Animals manifest, NPC agent, dialog scene and lines, and the taught-calling stat.

modules.name: Mod-wide
modules.summary: Plugin entry, the threat Switchboard (config to hw_switch stats), ActionUser, the shared noon/dusk/daylight clocks, project files, player docs, card motion, and art tooling state.
